answer: Reciprocity caps: every task thread logs payer and worker, and five graders compute each epoch's reputation delta per cluster of wallets sharing a funder. If over 60% of a cluster's gain comes from threads inside it, the excess is burned, so its score can never exceed 2.5x what outsiders paid it; 1,000 socks trading only with each other earn zero. Weakness: rings rent cheap outside partners. Fix: outside credit is weighted by the partner's timber, its sealed, age-locked work history, so renting fresh agents adds almost nothing.
